QUOTE: "**3. Detached worker: `ExternalBridge::run_async_ask`** ... runs `entropic_run` on a detached thread ... the worker captures `this` and `handle_`, but it is detached. `ExternalBridge::stop()` ... does not wait for in-flight async tasks."

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the async-ask worker as the one detached thread and says it has no join or wait in stop(), so it can outlive the handle.
